archetypes.name: test-fixture-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan prescribes ~10 test-case rewrites by approximate line number and 2 new positive cases; a specialist can verify these prescriptions are exhaustive, that stub env-var contracts align with the new dispatcher output keys, and that no PHASES_ATTEMPTED or LARCH_AGGREGATE_MAX_OUTER_PHASES references survive in uncited test cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether every occurrence of LARCH_AGGREGATE_MAX_OUTER_PHASES in test-aggregate-findings.sh is accounted for by the plan's rewrite list, not just the ~10 approximate line references. Verify that AGGREGATE_DISPATCH_SH stubs are prescribed to emit ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH (not only ALL_OUTPUT_FILES) after the collapse, matching the decompose-aggregator reference pattern the plan cites. Confirm the two new positive cases (test_dispatcher_pattern_gate_routes_narration_to_phase2, test_narrow_trigger_validator_failure_maps_to_validation_exhausted) exercise the actual changed logic rather than bypassing it entirely via stubs that never touch aggregate-findings.sh. Check that no remaining assertion on PHASES_ATTEMPTED or LARCH_AGGREGATE_MAX_OUTER_PHASES appears in any test case not listed for deletion. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: key-removal-survey
archetypes.rationale: The plan removes PHASES_ATTEMPTED, LARCH_AGGREGATE_MAX_OUTER_PHASES, aggregator-output-codex.txt, and aggregator-output-claude.txt but enumerates references only in the five listed files; other scripts, docs, or agent templates may still reference these identifiers, leaving stale cross-doc contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate every reference to PHASES_ATTEMPTED, LARCH_AGGREGATE_MAX_OUTER_PHASES, aggregator-output-codex.txt, and aggregator-output-claude.txt across the entire repo beyond the five plan-listed files, including docs/, skills/review/scripts/ siblings, SECURITY.md sections outside the single cited paragraph, and any agent templates. Identify references the plan's removal instructions do not cover and assess whether they would constitute a broken or misleading contract after the collapse. Verify the aggregate-findings.md Stdout key-list update fully eliminates PHASES_ATTEMPTED from its documented enum and that no other section of that doc contradicts the new single-slot behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pattern-gate-parity
archetypes.rationale: The --require-result-pattern '^[[:space:]]*### FINDING_[0-9]' must match the real heading template from orchestrator-aggregator.md and align with count_finding_blocks's existing grep; a single-digit-only bracket expression or whitespace mismatch would silently route every valid aggregation through phase-2 fallback.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed --require-result-pattern '^[[:space:]]*### FINDING_[0-9]' against the actual heading template in agents/orchestrator-aggregator.md and against the count_finding_blocks grep in aggregate-findings.sh, paying attention to whether findings above FINDING_9 exist (making [0-9] a single-digit-only match), whether the agent template ever emits leading whitespace before ###, and whether the pattern is BRE or ERE and whether that matters for the dispatch-with-waterfall.sh pattern-gate implementation. Verify that decompose-aggregator.sh's --require-result-pattern (the stated reference model) uses an identical or functionally equivalent pattern, confirming the new usage is a correct port rather than an independent invention with a latent divergence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
